title: French Satay Chicken
description: A French twist on the popular Southeast Asian satay dish, featuring chicken skewers marinated in a rich molasses-based sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine molasses, soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Serve skewers hot with a side of sticky rice and garnished with chopped cilantro.
Optional: serve with a side of fix sauce (see note)
